flashcard_questions.a: An economy that no longer depends on heavy industry and manufacturing.
The knowledge economy — jobs in research and development.

flashcard_questions.q: Where are science and business parks typically located?
flashcard_questions.a: On the outskirts of cities near good transport links and universities.

flashcard_questions.q: Why is a science park more environmentally sustainable than traditional industry?
flashcard_questions.a: It produces less pollution and uses lighter components for transport.

flashcard_questions.a: A chain reaction where spending in one area creates more jobs, income and further spending.

flashcard_questions.a: Blasting for limestone creates noise and dust.
